title: TNA SP 106/10: two Italian intercepts in a letter-and-figure syllabary, c. 1623-24 (DECODE R704, R721)

steps.what: Fetched DECODE metadata for R657, R660, R664, R704, R720, R721 and the pointers; identified the seventh record as R722 and a key record R725 in the same run of shelfmarks. Downloaded all 28 images with the project cookie.

Surveyed all 22 ciphertext pages and found they use three different systems, not one: R657 (two-figure), R660/R664/R720 (three-figure), R704/R721/R722 (letter-plus-figure). DECODE groups R720 with R704; the figures show it belongs with R660/R664.
Entry split from sp106box10 under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): system C, R704 and R721. Not attempted yet.

outcome.method_basis: Not attempted beyond identifying the system and separating it from the other ciphers of the file; the codebreaker's interlinear syllables are on the pages.
outcome.notes: Split on 14 Oct 2026 from sp106box10. Status in progress.

gaps.item: R704 and R721, the whole text
gaps.detail: no transcription and no gloss alignment done

prior.where: the contemporary codebreaker's interlinear syllables on R704 and R721
